A high-fashion luxury campaign photograph, elegant, chic and poised, in soft muted colour, made on a quiet stone street in hard midday sun: She sits sideways on the wide pale stone steps in a high-fashion editorial pose: one leg stretched long down the steps, the other bent, leaning back on one elbow; our bag stands upright on the step beside her hip.

References: Image 1 is THE SHOPPING BAG: our matte warm ivory bag with flat espresso ribbon handles; take its exact proportions, folded cuff and handles. Image 2 is THE WOMAN (character 13): about 28, Irish, fair freckled skin, straight auburn shoulder-length hair, slim build, slim freckled hands. Face not shown. Use only the face, hair, skin, hands and build from this sheet; ignore the clothes in it. Image 3 is THE OUTFIT: take exactly this long black cocoon coat with the wide wrapped collar, black wide trousers pooling on the floor and black pointed boots. The output is one single photograph, portrait 4:5.

Shot: Camera low at the height of the bag, 50mm lens, f/5.6, square to the bag front. The bag stands on the centre line, front square to the camera, filling about 40 percent of the frame width, sharp; behind it her reclined figure in the long black coat makes a long diagonal line down the steps, one pointed boot stretched to the frame edge; hard sun throws strong stepped shadows; frame cropped at her shoulders. Her body from the shoulders down is in frame in a long, angular, relaxed high-fashion pose, in exactly the outfit from the reference. Her face is never visible: she is turned away or cropped by the frame, and no face, cheek, chin or profile shows.

Place: A quiet city street of the fashion house at midday: pale weathered stone walls and steps, smooth pavement, the atelier's deep stone doorway; nothing else unless the shot names it.

Light: Hard, direct midday sun from high on one side: crisp black shadows with sharp edges, long shadows on the pavement, bright stone, no fill.

Palette and grade: Soft, muted colour: pale warm limestone, soft faded blacks, ivory and stone tones, natural skin, gently desaturated like a faded colour print; no strong or saturated colour, no blue or orange cast. The design surface is the cleanest white in the frame.

Real: this is a product mockup photograph for a fashion campaign, so the design surface is the hero: it stays sharp, clean and fully readable inside the effect, never covered by it. It is a real photograph made in camera by a campaign photographer, not a render and not a digital filter. The design surface faces the camera almost square-on, within about 15 degrees, so it reads flat and undistorted; its four edges run parallel to the edges of the photograph, a true rectangle, never a trapezoid or keystone; flat things on a table are shot from nearly straight above. Only the objects named in the shot are on set. The design surface is new and clean, crisp at its edges and corners, without blowing out. Every object is at its true real-world size next to her hands and body; nothing is enlarged for the camera.

Design surface: THE BAG FRONT IS PLAIN MATTE PAPER-WHITE BOARD, flat with crisp folded edges and a deep folded top cuff, nothing printed on it.

Finish: Shot on 35mm Kodak Portra 160, slightly overexposed and printed soft: fine visible grain, gentle faded colour, soft blacks, smooth highlights, the hard sun shadows still crisp. Calm and editorial like a printed fashion campaign; never glossy, never a digital render. Styled like a top fashion house campaign: poised, unhurried posture, the long clean line of the coat, slender hands with relaxed, graceful fingers, generous calm negative space of pale stone, quiet and expensive, never casual or snapshot-like.

Avoid: a face, chin, lips or profile, logos, letters or brand names anywhere, jewellery, saturated or strong colour, any object not named in the shot, other people, a clean, smooth digital look.
